note: Developed RV park on the Century Casino grounds, a paved loop of angled pads beside the casino - not a casino overnight lot. A belt of bottomland forest about 80-90 m deep lies between the pads and the Mississippi. --Claude
summary: Operator's RV park page (live 403; Wayback 2025): $60/night + tax (was $50 in 2023), Good Sam/club discounts, open year round, no reservation needed, phone 573-843-4777 confirmed. Site count/hookups not stated by the operator (stored 27 pull-throughs left). Price gate fails.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (price gate): '$60 per night + Tax' on the operator's page (2025 captures; live page Cloudflare-blocked, so unread for 2026); Good Sam Park at 10% off = $54, still over US$50; no gateway within 40 km (nearest Memphis 121 km); not stayed at. RV Life 4* $$ over 105 reviews (avg_rate 31, stale); the Google Maps listing found is the casino itself (3.7 over 2,657), no separate RV-park listing found.
Confirmed a real RV park, not an overnight lot: Esri imagery shows a paved loop with ~25-30 angled pads, RVs parked on them, and a small service building, on the river side of the casino.

WATERFRONT lead (operator claim vs stored not waterfront): the operator says 'right on the banks of the Mississippi River'. Measured on leaf-off Esri imagery: the east row of pads is ~80-90 m from the river's edge, all of it dense bottomland forest; no open apron. Not on-water; no campsite photo read showing a filtered river view, so it stays not waterfront.

Website: stored https://www.cnty.com/caruthersville/hotel-rv/ is the old page path; the operator's RV page is now https://www.cnty.com/caruthersville/rv-park/ (both refuse plain HTTP with Cloudflare 403). Phone 573-843-4777 confirmed ('RV Park Information').
